channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park Pavilion
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park Pavilion (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park Pavilion: The map notes gave 12 acres for Mission Creek Park and called the pavilion adjacent to the Channel Street Dog Park; no cited source says either (Rec & Park says 'nearby'), so dated corrections were added and the summary no longer says adjacent. The NAIP aerial's credit now names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, as its catalog record does, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.
